messages:
Maya: Quick design sync - I pushed a prototype for the compact Playground streaming UX. Main things I want feedback on: compact-banner vs bubble-overlay for the streaming indicator, a single primary stop control pattern, token badge behavior in compressed layouts, and prompt-library quick insert behavior (avoid huge composer jumps). Screenshots + prototype link in thread.

Aisha: Looked at the prototype. Compact-banner is less clipping-prone for tiny widths. Banner across top of chat pane reads cleaner on mobile. For desktop, overlay on the last message feels nicer and keeps the banner area free.

Sam: Implementation constraints: overlay must be absolutely positioned to avoid layout thrash. Using transform and will-change: transform helps with GPU compositing. For banner we can animate height via max-height to avoid reflow too. Example JS snippet:
```js
// simple throttle for stream indicator updates
let last = 0; function setStream(msg){ if(Date.now()-last<80) return; updateIndicator(msg); last=Date.now(); }
```
Helps with rapid chunking.

Diego: Single primary control idea: show a compact icon-only stop button while streaming in compact mode, but expand to "Stop response" with label on hover or in regular mode. Avoid having both stop and pause. Users confused by pause/resume semantics.

Noor: Accessibility: icon-only controls need accessible names and focus ring. Use `aria-label` like "Stop response" and `role=button`. Keyboard: space/enter to trigger. Also announce streaming state changes using `role=status` and `aria-live=polite`.

Liam: Token badge placement suggestion: in compact mode, tuck the token badge into a small pill inside the composer footer (right-aligned). On hover or focus it expands to detailed numbers. SR-only text should read "Tokens: 98 (approx)". Also include option to hide the badge in settings for non-power users.

Aisha: Copy micro tweak: show abbreviated token numbers visually (e.g., "~98 tkns") and full human-readable in tooltip ("Approx. 98 tokens used for last response"). Keep labels short to reduce visual noise.

Maya: For prompt library quick-insert, current behavior inserts raw template text and pushes conversation. Proposal: insert a collapsed snippet card with the prompt title + compressed preview and a small "Expand" control. Clicking Expand replaces the snippet with full prompt in the composer. Also show toast "Prompt added" with undo.

Sam: Technical note: collapsed snippet should be a single lightweight DOM node with the prompt id, not the full template text. On expand, we fetch template from prompt service. This avoids large documents and keeps history small. Also add client-side debouncing so repeated inserts don't fire multiple network requests.

Noor: Accessibility for snippet: snippet card should be keyboard-focusable with `tabindex=0` and use `aria-expanded="false"` initially. Screen reader should announce "Prompt snippet: <title>. Press Enter to expand". Undo toast should be in the live region and reachable by keyboard.

Diego: Edge case: if user pastes while a snippet is collapsed, we need clear precedence. I propose that expand transforms to editable text; paste goes into editor as usual. Also provide small badge to convert snippet to plain text.

Aisha: Regenerate wording: prefer "Regenerate response" as explicit label and show it only after the stream completes. For compact mode, use icon-only circular arrow with accessible label. Avoid ambiguous "Retry" or "Redo".

Maya: UX question: should regenerate reuse KV cache or bypass? Sam?

Sam: We'll add a flag: regenerate_bypass_cache boolean default false. If customers want deterministic variations we can expose option later. For now, regenerate will cancel inflight and spawn new request, honoring same prompt+context.

Liam: Accessibility checklist I'll draft: 1) All controls get aria-labels, 2) streaming status uses role=status & aria-live, 3) token badge tooltip accessible via keyboard, 4) snippet uses aria-expanded and focus management, 5) toasts reachable and dismissible. I'll post checklist later.

Design-bot: Figma file updated: https://www.figma.com/file/abc/playground-compact-stream-v2 5 comments.

Maya: Next steps: Aisha iterate compact-banner + overlay variants, Sam prototype throttle/position behaviors, Noor review keyboard flows, Liam finalize a11y checklist. Target: internal review next Wed.

Diego: Tiny nit: animation for banner in/out should be 120ms ease-out, don't use long easing to avoid attention grab.

Aisha: Will do. Adding copy: token pill label "~98 tkns" and streaming bubble label "Streaming…" with ellipsis.

Maya: Thanks all 20 — will follow up with PRD + acceptance criteria and link to figma.
